name: raisetalks
description: Connect to RaiseTalks: founders build and update their data room, investors browse startups and manage their deal pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Data rooms, startup catalog and investor pipeline
interface.longDescription: Founders read and update their RaiseTalks data room (company, team, market, financials, roadmap, partners and backers) and get upload links for pitch decks and documents. Investors browse the startup catalog, open data rooms they have access to, and move startups through their deal pipeline. Sign in with your existing RaiseTalks account.
defaultPrompt: Show me what's missing from my data room
Add our new CTO to the team section
List the startups in my pipeline that are in due diligence
